updates: Extends the constructor-only UTF-8 result in contract-pass.json to five parser methods and two checked caller lemmas.
properties: At normal-return boundaries the pending buffer has at most three bytes.
An error from push_bytes preserves the entry buffer length.
Successful finish empties the buffer; an error preserves its entry length.
Construction starts empty; consuming an empty parser succeeds.
Checked lemmas call the real methods to compose construction with a chunk and to preserve length across two errors.
readability: Imported requires/ensures/refined/may_panic macros use Rust names, len(), is_empty(), result, old(expr), and if/else. Generic payloads can stay opaque while selected fields are modeled. Lemmas are ordinary checked Rust functions. Codex still uses cfg_attr wrappers; the type invariant still uses a raw Flux length projection.
model_trust: External UTF-8 decoder bounds, byte Vec mutation lengths, and leak-safe prefix drain bounds are trusted assumptions audited against Rust 8925ea358a0f. Native checks supplement the audit. See Flux handoff/COLLECTION-MODELS.md.
panic_scope: push_bytes, finish, into_inner and the caller lemmas explicitly permit panics. Their contracts cover normal returns, including Err, not caught unwind states. Strict overflow remains enabled. A native callback panic exposes six pending bytes; this is not a panic-free API claim.
soundness_regression: A minimized example initially accepted a false postcondition after catch_unwind. The checker now rejects that unsupported standard boundary, including fn-pointer coercion and runs without standard models. Other recovery/concurrency mechanisms and general destructor effects remain unproved.

validation.rustdoc: Passes; 67 extern-spec examples intentionally ignored. A proof-only module attribute initially broke rustdoc and is now gated on cfg(flux).
validation.native_coverage: Exact buffered bytes and callback text checked across all 1024 partitions of Aé中🦀Z with invalid chunks injected before every chunk. Decoder checks include every Unicode scalar prefix and all one/two-byte inputs; drain checks include partial iteration and leaks.
mutations: Drain zero bytes instead of the valid prefix
validation.mutation_result: All four rejected with proof failures; each restored byte-for-byte with the positive source patch hash.
validation.performance_scope: Single host/default-feature observations. Five cached bodies avoid new solver queries. Generated type-witness helper bodies are excluded from the seven handwritten body count; unselected dependencies are not proved.
validation.format: cargo fmt --all and just fmt passed

remaining: Prove buffer contents and exact callback history with sequence models.
Propagate contracts through concrete parser implementations and all callers.
Model unwind transitions, recovery/concurrency mechanisms and general destructor effects.
Support Rust-shaped struct invariants and eliminate cfg_attr scaffolding through native dependency integration.
The remaining Codex corpus and other platform/feature configurations remain incomplete.
scope: Seven selected handwritten bodies; coverage also records six generated Rust type-witness helpers and unselected bodies. Dependency proofs are not collected. Acceptance with observed models is not whole-program verification.
reproduce:
Build the recorded Flux commit, then run tools/codex/corpus.py check --source --flux --package codex-utils-stream-parser --only-check 'def:Utf8StreamParser::

::' --only-check 'def:state_proofs::' --timeout 120 --offline --proof-cache --output .
